name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 6 visits over 11 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2025-05-26, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.23 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
